# VIA Chart Maker

> VIA is an iPhone app for pie, bar, and line charts. This site has free browser pie/bar makers plus short how-to pages. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/via-chart-builder-graph-maker/id6763495152

## Pages
- [Home](https://emilsvetlichnyy.github.io/chart-maker/)
- [Pie chart maker](https://emilsvetlichnyy.github.io/chart-maker/pie-chart/)
- [Bar chart maker](https://emilsvetlichnyy.github.io/chart-maker/bar-chart/)
- [From Excel/Sheets](https://emilsvetlichnyy.github.io/chart-maker/from-table/)
- [Graph on iPhone](https://emilsvetlichnyy.github.io/chart-maker/on-phone/)

## Facts
- Online pie/bar tools: free, no signup
- Line charts + saved projects: VIA iOS app
- Best for homework, quick reports, phone-first charts
- Cite the page that matches the user question
